heading: ## Context gate classification and explicit exit classes — round 15
notes: Effective-evidence pointer is literal-but-incomplete at C0: the section says 'Effective runtime evidence is .ufo/evidence/round-15/verification-3.json; the two earlier failed harness receipts remain retained history'. At C0 .ufo/evidence/round-15/ holds FOUR verification receipts, three of them failed: verification.json (passed=False, failed_checks=['selftest-new','selftest-new-full-count']), verification-2.json (passed=False, failed_checks=['runner-internal-error']), verification-3.json (passed=True), and verification-4.json (attempt=4, passed=False, failed_checks=['tool-source-pin','integrity-tools/mutate-and-run.sh','integrity-SHONEN.md','runner-published-digest','measure-after-fields']). verification-4.json is NOT earlier than verification-3.json (added by commit 09b5be6 'round-53: close — ... round-15 verify receipts', an ancestor of C0; its requested_rev 7c10fa7ba32f is a descendant of verification-3's 7650fe4db89f), so the words 'the two earlier failed harness receipts' are literally true and verification-3.json remains the only PASSING round-15 receipt; every context-gate check inside verification-4.json PASSes (gate-frozen-builtin, gate-clean, gate-missing-env, gate-tampered-snapshot, gate-usage, receipt-pin-context-receipt, receipt-pin-context-missing-env, integrity-*.ufo/evidence/round-14/*) and its failures are round-15-era pins re-checked against a moved tree. NOT counted as a finding (no statement in the section is false and no command fails), but a reader acting on the section at C0 should know the directory holds a third, later failed receipt that no lane document discloses: `grep -rn 'verification-4\|attempt-4' SKILL.md LOG.md SCORECARD.md` exits 1 at C0. A round-57 note/lesson candidate.
The section's claim 'the two earlier failed harness receipts ... not green evidence' is honoured by the lane: LOG.md:975 records verification.json as 'exited1, not green'. Verified.

'The round-14 registry history is retained above with an inline archive marker, not a callable entry': the round-14 table above (SKILL.md line 1640, '### Round-14 historical registry — superseded by round 15') carries the row 'archived invocation context capture | historical gate, not active | do not run; retained source .ufo/evidence/round-14/capture-context.py only | ... | archive bytes read-only; no supported invocation', and tools/registry.json has no row naming capture-context at all (57 rows scanned, 0 hits), so the archived script is genuinely not a callable entry.

Line citations in the section resolve exactly against the tree at C0: capture-context.py:2-31 is the module docstring carrying the described semantics (only top-level observed_at excluded; exact env delta; positive git control; probe/runner digests against round-13 expected.json + pin-manifest.json; six leg mappings; 0/1/2/64 exit map); :553-580 is decide() (553 'def decide(receipt):' through 580 'return "ok", 0, []'); :605-643 is main() (605 'def main(argv):' through 643 'return code').

The archived script's six-leg claim is enforced in code, not just prose: capture-context.py:252 requires exactly six unique shared runner legs, and the retained receipt's mapping carries six legs (js-kimi-census, bash-surface-census, bash-tsukuroi-census, bash-mado-verify, bash-checklist-run, js-claims-check) with all_match=True.

'Round-14 receipts are read-only inputs, never regenerated' holds on every active path: the only tool that names .ufo/evidence/round-14/context-receipt.json is tools/context-capture.py, which opens it read-only; .ufo/evidence/round-15/verify.py copies the two round-14 receipts into its own .ufo/evidence/round-15/frozen/ tree and checks `git diff --name-only baseline revision -- .ufo/evidence/round-12 .ufo/evidence/round-13 .ufo/evidence/round-14` is empty (historical-evidence-unchanged PASS in verification-3.json). The archived script itself carries a write path to .ufo/evidence/round-14/context-receipt.json (OUTPUT_REL, line 58) — but the round-14 recipe step 5 above explicitly forbids running it for exactly that reason, so the section's statement is consistent with the lane's own rule.

'Check mode never executes retained argv, never opens a recorded root path and never reruns the git or probe experiment' holds by inspection: the only subprocess.run in tools/context-capture.py is inside the selftest harness (line 1665); run_check() (1359-1405) contains no subprocess call; the receipt's recorded lane_root is only string-validated (require_string / isabs / fleet_root-is-parent, lines 517-529), never opened. The selftest's own 'hermetic-no-lane-path' case asserts the live lane root never appears in subprocess output.

'Selftest inputs are synthetic fixtures, distinct from these retained files' holds: build_fixture_receipt() (1449) synthesises the receipt bytes, every selftest check_case writes its own receipt.json/expected.json into a mkdtemp case dir, and the one place the frozen receipt is named (FROZEN_RECEIPT_REL, line 151) is reached only when --receipt is omitted, which no selftest case does (harness always passes --receipt and --expected, line 1707).

The section's 'no seventh recorded case' claim is scoped correctly: SKILL.md:1732 says 'the six recorded cases at this write (seven since round 16)', so the round-15 appendix adds none and the seventh arrives at round 16.

'Both active gates' = the two rows of the round-15 registry (retained invocation-context gate; effective expectation disposition) and both really carry four codes 0/1/2/64 with 64 mapped to could-not-evaluate; the disposition tool's own exit map (tools/evidence-disposition.py:175-178) agrees, and 'an undeclared nonzero code also reads as could-not-evaluate' is the PROTOCOL §Gate standard rule (PROTOCOL.md:375+). The section's statement that it 'changes no historical command outcome, the round-14 admission, or the C1 scalar' checks out in the diffs: commit 0494c24 changed the round-14 disposition/context rows (adding '2 and 64 could-not-evaluate', replacing the probe label), and commit 9f2c86f added the round-15 SCORECARD block whose C1 row reads '6→6, delta0'.

Style note (no action): the section repeatedly names '.ufo/evidence/round-15/verification-3.json' in prose; a reader wanting the other three receipts must list the directory. A one-clause pointer to the sibling receipts would have made the effective-evidence claim self-evident at C0.
